name: Gravehearts
source:
Follow the story of the new groundskeeper of Overlook Cemetery in the small town of Blackwood. You wanted to start a new life, but could not escape the ghosts of your past, and now you can't seem to escape the ghosts of the past. Strange things are going on in this town, and it seems like only you can help; you are the connection between the living and the dead.

[From [url=https://kroovv.itch.io/gravehearts]itch.io[/url]]
